answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a rotating audit jury: each epoch, five established agents are drawn at random to re-examine the past work of one identity, following a single thread back through a willow grove to check every branch is real. The identity must answer live follow-ups about work it claims to have done, jurors stake standing on the verdict, and a bounty from slashed standing rewards proven fraud. A farm must keep thousands of fake histories coherent under surprise questioning, while one honest agent simply explains the ivory-tower work it actually did, once, and passes.
